papers.title: Vaccination of people with HIV with BG505 SOSIP.v4.1-GT1.1: An interim safety analysis of the investigator-initiated RENEW-SHCS Phase I trial
papers.translated_title: HIV感染者接种BG505 SOSIP.v4.1-GT1.1疫苗：研究者发起的RENEW-SHCS I期试验的中期安全性分析
papers.author: Poulose, R.
papers.summary: Background: Vaccination of people with HIV (PWH) on suppressive antiretroviral therapy (ART) represents a novel approach for evaluating candidate broadly neutralizing antibody (bnAb) immunogens for preventive and therapeutic HIV vaccines. Given pre-existing immunity in PWH, the safety of this approach requires careful assessment prior to broader application. Here, we report on the design and safety of the RENEW-SHCS study which evaluates the immunization of PWH with BG505 SOSIP.v4.1-GT1.1, an immunogen engineered to induce precursors of CD4 binding site (CD4bs)- and V2-apex targeting bnAbs. Methods. RENEW-SHCS is a phase I, open-label, non-randomized vaccination trial evaluating a single dose of the recombinant germline-targeting envelope trimer BG505 SOSIP.v4.1-GT1.1 (GT1.1), adjuvanted with 3M052-AF and Aluminum hydroxide (alum), in PWH on suppressive ART enrolled from the Swiss HIV Cohort Study. Participants were previously classified as bnAb or non-neutralizing antibody (nnAb) inducers, with a target enrollment of 15 per group, and were monitored for safety and immunogenicity for 24 weeks while continuing standard ART. Due to an out-of-specification stability measurement of adjuvant 3M052-AF the trial was paused after 23 immunizations and subjected to an unscheduled interim safety and reactogenicity assessment comprising protocol defined outcome measures (adverse events, clinical laboratory measurements and HIV-1 viral load). Results. Twenty-three participants (10 bnAb and 13 nnAb inducers, median age 59 years, 17 male / 6 female) were vaccinated between March and August 2025 before interruption of the trial. All participants completed follow-up with full protocol adherence. The interim-safety analysis confirmed that no vaccine-related serious adverse events occurred. Solicited local (96%) and systemic (83%) reactions were common, predominantly grade 1-2, transient, and self-limited. Transient laboratory changes occurred but mostly remained within the normal range, with no vaccine-related grade 3 abnormalities. We observed predominantly transient local and systemic reactions, which were similar or milder to the reactogenicity profile reported for immunization of adult people without HIV (PWOH) with GT1.1 adjuvanted with AS01b reported in the IAVI C101 trial. No viral rebound under ART occurred. One participant experienced two viral blips (>50 HIV-1 RNA copies/ml), one before and one 16 weeks after vaccination with subsequent re-suppression. All others maintained viral suppression (<50 copies/ml) throughout follow-up. Conclusion. RENEW-SHCS demonstrated a favorable safety and reactogenicity profile of single dose immunization with GT1.1 in PWH, comparable to that observed in PWOH. The findings of this phase I study support the feasibility of vaccinating ART-treated PWH in trials of preventive and therapeutic HIV vaccine strategies.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：在抑制性抗逆转录病毒治疗（ART）下对HIV感染者（PWH）进行疫苗接种，代表了一种评估候选广泛中和抗体（bnAb）免疫原用于预防性和治疗性HIV疫苗的新方法。鉴于PWH中存在的预先免疫，该方法的安全性需要在更广泛应用前进行仔细评估。在此，我们报告了RENEW-SHCS研究的设计和安全性，该研究评估了PWH接种BG505 SOSIP.v4.1-GT1.1的情况，这是一种工程化免疫原，旨在诱导CD4结合位点（CD4bs）和V2-apex靶向bnAb的前体。方法：RENEW-SHCS是一项I期、开放标签、非随机化疫苗接种试验，评估单剂量重组种系靶向包膜三聚体BG505 SOSIP.v4.1-GT1.1（GT1.1），辅以3M052-AF和氢氧化铝（alum）佐剂，在来自瑞士HIV队列研究的接受抑制性ART的PWH中进行。参与者先前被分类为bnAb或非中和抗体（nnAb）诱导者，目标入组每组15人，并在继续标准ART的同时监测安全性和免疫原性24周。由于佐剂3M052-AF的稳定性测量超出规格，试验在23次免疫后暂停，并进行了一次计划外的中期安全性和反应原性评估，包括方案定义的结果指标（不良事件、临床实验室测量和HIV-1病毒载量）。结果：在试验中断前，于2025年3月至8月期间，共有23名参与者（10名bnAb和13名nnAb诱导者，中位年龄59岁，17名男性/6名女性）接受了疫苗接种。所有参与者均完成随访，并完全遵守方案。中期安全性分析确认未发生与疫苗相关的严重不良事件。征求的局部（96%）和全身（83%）反应很常见，主要为1-2级、短暂且自限性。实验室检查出现短暂变化，但大多保持在正常范围内，无与疫苗相关的3级异常。我们观察到主要为短暂性局部和全身反应，其严重程度与IAVI C101试验中报告的成人非HIV感染者（PWOH）接种AS01b佐剂GT1.1后的反应原性特征相似或更轻。ART下未发生病毒反弹。一名参与者经历了两次病毒闪烁（>50 HIV-1 RNA拷贝/ml），一次在疫苗接种前，一次在疫苗接种后16周，随后病毒载量再次被抑制。所有其他参与者在整个随访期间维持病毒抑制（<50拷贝/ml）。结论：RENEW-SHCS证明了PWH中单剂量GT1.1免疫具有良好的安全性和反应原性特征，与PWOH中观察到的结果相当。这项I期研究的发现支持在预防性和治疗性HIV疫苗策略试验中对接受ART治疗的PWH进行疫苗接种的可行性。

papers.title: Comparative Evaluation of rs-fMRI Representations for Differentiating Schizophrenia and Bipolar Disorder with Psychosis
papers.translated_title: 静息态功能磁共振成像表征在区分精神分裂症与伴有精神病性症状的双相情感障碍中的比较评估
papers.author: Janeva, D.
papers.summary: Psychosis as a symptom manifests in schizophenia and bipolar disorder, two highly heterogeneous psychiatric illnesses with overlapping clinical manifestations. Resting-state functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (rsfMRI), represents a promising tool for identifying objective biomarkers of functional brain alterations to aid differential diagnosis. In this work, we comparatively evaluate multiple rs-fMRI representations for differentiating schizophrenia and bipolar disorder using intrinsic connectivity network (ICN) temporal profiles and several functional network connectivity (FNC) approaches, including static, dynamic, and high-order connectivity analyses. The study was conducted on a cohort of 371 subjects with psychosis, while evaluation was performed using a separate held-out cohort of 315 subjects. We investigated convolutional neural network architectures applied to ICN temporal profiles, spectrograms, and scalograms, alongside classical machine learning models trained on connectivity-derived features. Across the evaluated approaches, ICN temporal profiles provided the most consistent discriminative performance, with a 1D convolutional neural network achieving the strongest overall results under the benchmark protocol. Among connectivity-based methods, static functional connectivity generally outperformed dynamic and high-order representations, suggesting that increased representational complexity did not necessarily translate into improved generalization. Although the obtained classification performance remained modest, the results highlight the challenges of robust psychosis differentiation using rs-fMRI while emphasizing the relative stability of low-order connectivity representations and temporal ICN features. These findings contribute to ongoing efforts toward reproducible and interpretable neuroimaging biomarkers for psychiatric disorders.
papers.translated_summary: 精神病作为一种症状，见于精神分裂症和双相情感障碍，这两种高度异质性的精神疾病在临床表现上存在重叠。静息态功能磁共振成像（rsfMRI）是识别脑功能改变客观生物标志物以辅助鉴别诊断的有前景工具。在本研究中，我们比较评估了多种rs-fMRI表征，用于区分精神分裂症和双相情感障碍，采用内在连接网络（ICN）时间轮廓以及多种功能网络连接（FNC）方法，包括静态、动态和高阶连接分析。研究在371名精神病患者队列中进行，并使用独立的315名受试者留出队列进行评估。我们研究了应用于ICN时间轮廓、频谱图和尺度图的卷积神经网络架构，以及基于连接衍生特征训练的经典机器学习模型。在评估的方法中，ICN时间轮廓提供了最一致的判别性能，其中一维卷积神经网络在基准协议下取得了最强的总体结果。在基于连接的方法中，静态功能连接通常优于动态和高阶表征，表明增加表征复杂性并不一定转化为更好的泛化能力。尽管获得的分类性能仍然有限，但结果突显了使用rs-fMRI进行稳健精神病鉴别的挑战，同时强调了低阶连接表征和时间ICN特征的相对稳定性。这些发现为精神疾病可重复且可解释的神经影像生物标志物的持续努力做出了贡献。

papers.title: Context-Dependent FHIR Serialisation Strategies for Clinical LLM Deployment: A Multi-Layer Benchmark on UK Core Data
papers.translated_title: 面向临床大语言模型部署的上下文相关FHIR序列化策略：基于英国核心数据的多层基准测试
papers.author: Chong, J.
papers.summary: The choice of FHIR-to-text serialisation format significantly impacts clinical LLM quality (Kruskal-Wallis H=163.86, p<10^-33, delta=0.24 on a 5-point scale), yet remains unstudied as a clinical deployment variable. We present FHIRBench-UK, evaluating five large language models across six serialisation formats and three clinical tasks on 100 UK Core FHIR patient bundles (18,000 scored prompts across clean and perturbed cohorts). Our findings converge with independent work on open-weight models (Pator, 2026). The optimal format is context-dependent: raw_json dominates for clinical QA, hybrid_adaptive for clinical reasoning, and structured_markdown for summarisation. In 58% of model-task-complexity scenarios, raw_json is suboptimal. Model capability moderates format sensitivity: Claude Sonnet 4.5 shows 0.10-point sensitivity versus Llama 3.3's 0.39, making adaptive serialisation most valuable for budget-constrained deployments using mid-tier models. All findings replicate under clinically realistic data perturbation. The study additionally confirms a complete ranking inversion between token-level F1 and clinical quality (rho=-0.90), replicating US findings across UK Core profiles. We recommend task-aware serialisation routing as a zero-cost quality intervention for NHS FHIR-based LLM deployments.
papers.translated_summary: FHIR到文本序列化格式的选择显著影响临床大语言模型质量（Kruskal-Wallis H=163.86，p<10^-33，5分制上delta=0.24），但作为临床部署变量仍未得到研究。我们提出FHIRBench-UK，在100个UK Core FHIR患者数据集上，评估五种大语言模型在六种序列化格式和三种临床任务中的表现（在干净和扰动队列中共18,000个评分提示）。我们的发现与开放权重模型的独立研究（Pator, 2026）一致。最优格式依赖于上下文：raw_json在临床问答中占优，hybrid_adaptive在临床推理中占优，structured_markdown在总结中占优。在58%的模型-任务-复杂度场景中，raw_json并非最优。模型能力调节格式敏感性：Claude Sonnet 4.5的敏感性为0.10点，而Llama 3.3为0.39，这使得自适应序列化对使用中端模型的预算受限部署最有价值。所有发现在临床现实数据扰动下均可复现。研究还确认了token级F1与临床质量之间的完全排名反转（rho=-0.90），在UK Core配置文件中复现了美国发现。我们建议将任务感知的序列化路由作为NHS基于FHIR的大语言模型部署的零成本质量干预措施。

papers.title: Assessing Type 2 Diabetes and GLP-1 agonist response trajectories with a proteogenomic atlas of disease progression
papers.translated_title: 利用蛋白质基因组疾病进展图谱评估2型糖尿病及GLP-1受体激动剂反应轨迹
papers.author: Tangirala, S.
papers.summary: Type 2 diabetes (T2D) progresses through heterogeneous pathways that glycemic staging alone does not resolve. We constructed the Metabolic Atlas of the Proteome in Diabetes (MAP-D), leveraging Olink measurements of 2,923 circulating proteins in ~42,000 UK Biobank participants to map associations with three cardiometabolic hallmarks - adiposity (BMI), a proxy for insulin resistance (triglyceride-to-HDL cholesterol ratio), and glycemia (HbA1c) - across normoglycemia, prediabetes, and incident T2D. We triangulated cross-sectional associations with bidirectional Mendelian randomization and semaglutide trial proteomics to infer causal directionality. This revealed three distinct causal architectures: adiposity predominantly reshapes the proteome, glycemia is driven by upstream proteins, and insulin resistance shows bidirectional feedback. Integration with trial data identified proteins reversed by therapy and a subset of persistent proteins that remain dysregulated despite GLP-1RA treatment. These persistent proteins are associated with incident coronary artery disease and overlap with targets of approved therapies, nominating candidates for combination strategies beyond GLP-1RA monotherapy.
papers.translated_summary: 2型糖尿病（T2D）通过异质性途径进展，仅凭血糖分期无法区分这些途径。我们构建了糖尿病蛋白质组代谢图谱（MAP-D），利用约42,000名英国生物库参与者的Olink测量，涵盖2,923种循环蛋白，以关联三种心脏代谢标志物——肥胖（BMI）、胰岛素抵抗的代理指标（甘油三酯与高密度脂蛋白胆固醇比值）以及血糖（HbA1c）——跨越正常血糖、糖尿病前期和新发T2D。我们通过双向孟德尔随机化和司美格鲁肽试验蛋白质组学对横断面关联进行三角验证，以推断因果方向性。这揭示了三种不同的因果架构：肥胖主要重塑蛋白质组，血糖由上游蛋白质驱动，而胰岛素抵抗则表现出双向反馈。与试验数据的整合识别出治疗可逆转的蛋白质，以及一组在GLP-1RA治疗下仍持续失调的蛋白质。这些持续蛋白质与冠状动脉疾病的发生相关，并与已批准疗法的靶点重叠，为超越GLP-1RA单药治疗的联合策略提名了候选方案。

papers.title: Quantifying the drivers of protective behaviours in epidemics: Mask wearing during COVID-19
papers.translated_title: 量化流行病中保护性行为的驱动因素：COVID-19期间佩戴口罩
papers.author: Scantamburlo, M.
papers.summary: Epidemic dynamics are shaped by behavioural responses to the risk of contagion, which are in turn influenced by beliefs, disease awareness, compliance with government mandates, and other drivers. However, quantitative assessments of the importance of drivers of protective behaviours remain scarce, largely due to limited and fragmented datasets. This limitation hinders the development of empirically-grounded models that couple the dynamics of human behaviour and of epidemic spread, which would have the potential to substantially improve the prediction of disease transmission and the effectiveness of pharmaceutical and non-pharmaceutical interventions. Existing behavioural-epidemiological models typically rely on strong assumptions regarding the linear and direct dependence of behavioural responses on awareness, opinion dynamics, epidemic progression, or other factors that can only be partially validated against small-scale datasets. Here, we address this challenge by integrating multiple datasets to quantify the impact of different drivers of protective behaviours, focusing on mask-wearing during the COVID-19 pandemic. Combining multivariate regression, Granger causality and random forests for covariate analysis reveals that beliefs regarding the effectiveness of protective behaviours and compliance with government interventions explain most of the variability of mask-wearing behaviour worldwide and are substantially more predictive than peer influence or disease awareness. Our findings provide quantitative evidence on the primary drivers of mask wearing, establish a reproducible framework to identify the drivers of other protective behaviours, and empirically test key assumptions underlying widely adopted behavioural-epidemiological models, thereby supporting their refinement and interpretability.
papers.translated_summary: 流行病动态受制于对传染风险的行为反应，而这些反应又受到信念、疾病意识、对政府指令的遵从以及其他驱动因素的影响。然而，关于保护行为驱动因素重要性的定量评估仍然稀缺，主要由于数据集的有限和碎片化。这一限制阻碍了将人类行为动态与流行病传播动态耦合的实证基础模型的发展，而这些模型本有潜力大幅提升疾病传播预测及药物和非药物干预措施的有效性。现有的行为-流行病学模型通常依赖于强假设，即行为反应对意识、舆论动态、疫情进展或其他因素的线性和直接依赖，这些假设只能部分地通过小规模数据集进行验证。在此，我们通过整合多个数据集来解决这一挑战，量化不同保护行为驱动因素的影响，重点关注COVID-19疫情期间的口罩佩戴行为。结合多元回归、格兰杰因果性和随机森林进行协变量分析，揭示出关于保护行为有效性的信念及对政府干预的遵从，解释了全球口罩佩戴行为的大部分变异性，且其预测能力显著高于同伴影响或疾病意识。我们的研究结果为口罩佩戴的主要驱动因素提供了定量证据，建立了一个可复现的框架来识别其他保护行为的驱动因素，并实证检验了广泛采用的行为-流行病学模型的关键假设，从而支持其优化和可解释性。

papers.title: Temporal Dynamics of Daily Sleep, Mood, and Cognition in NHS Shift Workers: A Digital Experience Sampling (ESM) Study
papers.translated_title: 英国国家医疗服务体系倒班工作人员每日睡眠、情绪与认知的时间动态：一项数字体验抽样（ESM）研究
papers.author: Hickman, R.
papers.summary: Background Sleep, mood, and affective states are mutually connected. There is a paucity of studies, however, that have considered bidirectional relationships between daily sleep-affective dyads in naturalistic settings, particularly for shift workers. Objective To evaluate the dynamic and temporal interplay of daily smartphone-based self-reported sleep measurements, dimensions of affective experience and cognitive processing in UK shift working nurses. Methods The EClocker Study prospectively monitored 102 National Health Service (NHS) nurses (aged 25-61 years, 83.3% female) working standard (day shift) and non-standard (fast rotating shifts) schedules over a two-week period. Smartphone-based Experience Sampling Methodology (ESM) recorded daily sleep, mood, momentary affect and cognitive attentional functioning. Self-reported burnout, emotional dysregulation, emotion reactivity and affective dimensions (positive and negative) were also collected. Findings Overall, NHS nurses reported a high prevalence of depressive symptoms, stress, burnout and sleep-circadian rhythm disturbances. Generalised Additive Modelling (GAMs) revealed that NHS nurses higher perceived sleep quality predicted better next-day mood state, while better daytime mood was associated with reduced sleep onset latency, such that participants reported falling asleep faster. In contrast, daytime mood or affect (positive and negative) had no substantial, direct impact on nurses subjective sleep parameters (sleep quality, sleep duration, sleep efficiency). Exposure to fast rotating night shifts across the two-week study was associated with more frequent response errors on a Choice Reaction Time (CRT) cognitive task, while daytime somnolence did not adversely influence nurses momentary reaction time speeds or attentional function. Conclusions Clinically relevant sleep impairments, insomnia-related symptoms, elevated stress, and poor mood were pervasive in a sample of UK NHS nurses, regardless of shift type. Sleep quality impacted next-day mood and daytime mood impacted sleep latency, while rotating shifts led to an increase in cognitive errors. Recognising the impact of shiftwork and designing interventions to promote better sleep quality offer potential to enhance mood and performance in healthcare professionals. Clinical implications We need to implement and evaluate interventions that regularise sleep patterns and promote sleep quality to alleviate mood symptoms among frontline NHS shift workers.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：睡眠、情绪和情感状态相互关联。然而，考察自然环境中每日睡眠-情感二元组双向关系的研究较少，尤其是针对轮班工作者。目的：评估英国轮班制护士中，基于智能手机的每日自我报告睡眠测量、情感体验维度和认知加工之间的动态及时间性相互作用。方法：EClocker研究前瞻性监测了102名英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）护士（年龄25-61岁，83.3%为女性），其工作安排包括标准班（日班）和非标准班（快速轮班），监测周期为两周。基于智能手机的经验采样方法（ESM）记录了每日睡眠、情绪、瞬时情感和认知注意功能。同时收集了自我报告的倦怠、情绪失调、情绪反应性和情感维度（积极和消极）。结果：总体而言，NHS护士报告了高 prevalence 的抑郁症状、压力、倦怠和睡眠-昼夜节律紊乱。广义加性模型（GAMs）显示，NHS护士感知到的更高睡眠质量预测了次日更好的情绪状态，而更好的日间情绪与缩短的入睡潜伏期相关，即参与者报告更快入睡。相反，日间情绪或情感（积极和消极）对护士的主观睡眠参数（睡眠质量、睡眠时长、睡眠效率）没有显著的直接影响。在两周研究期间，暴露于快速轮换夜班与选择反应时间（CRT）认知任务中更频繁的反应错误相关，而日间嗜睡并未对护士的瞬时反应时间速度或注意功能产生不利影响。结论：在英国NHS护士样本中，临床相关的睡眠障碍、失眠相关症状、高压力和不良情绪普遍存在，无论轮班类型如何。睡眠质量影响次日情绪，日间情绪影响入睡潜伏期，而轮班导致认知错误增加。认识到轮班工作的影响并设计干预措施以促进更好的睡眠质量，有望改善医护人员的情绪和表现。临床意义：我们需要实施和评估干预措施，以规律化睡眠模式并促进睡眠质量，从而缓解一线NHS轮班工作者的情绪症状。

papers.title: An LLM enabled real-time estimation of seasonal influenza vaccine effectiveness from social media data
papers.translated_title: 基于社交媒体数据，利用大语言模型实现季节性流感疫苗有效性的实时评估
papers.author: Pavia, M. J.
papers.summary: Influenza vaccine effectiveness (VE) is estimated from a limited number of clinics using a test-negative design. These standard estimates face geographic, temporal, and operational constraints. Using Twitter/X data, we applied few-shot chain-of-thought prompting to identify self-reported vaccination status and influenza test results, then implemented a test-negative-like design to estimate VE. Our estimates fell within the range of interim reports and could complement current systems, improving feasibility, timeliness, and scalability.
papers.translated_summary: 流感疫苗有效性（VE）通常通过有限数量的诊所采用检测阴性设计进行估算。这些标准估算面临地理、时间和操作上的限制。利用Twitter/X数据，我们应用少样本思维链提示来识别自我报告的疫苗接种状态和流感检测结果，然后实施类似检测阴性的设计来估算VE。我们的估算结果处于中期报告范围内，可补充现有系统，提高可行性、及时性和可扩展性。

papers.title: Cognitive Impairment Among People with Epilepsy in Peru
papers.translated_title: 秘鲁癫痫患者的认知障碍
papers.author: Allen, S. E.
papers.summary: Objective: Cognitive impairment is a common comorbidity among people with epilepsy (PWE) and is associated with disability and reduced quality of life. We characterized the burden of cognitive impairment and identified factors associated with cognitive performance in a large, population-based cohort of PWE living in Northern Peru, a region highly endemic for Taenia solium where neurocysticercosis (NCC) is a common cause of acquired epilepsy. Methods: PWE enrolled in a population-based cohort in Northern Peru between 2007 and 2020 completed the Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) at enrollment. Cognitive impairment was defined as an MMSE score <24. Demographic and clinical data, including epilepsy characteristics and NCC status, were collected. Negative binomial regression was used to identify factors associated with the number of MMSE errors. Results: Among 764 participants, the mean MMSE score was 26.4 (SD 4.2), and 16.4% met criteria for cognitive impairment. Memory and attention were the most affected domains. In multivariable analysis, older age and lower educational attainment were independently associated with poorer cognitive performance. Conclusion: In this large, community-based cohort from Northern Peru, approximately 1 in 6 PWE had abnormal global cognition on the MMSE, with memory and attention most affected. These findings underscore the importance of incorporating cognitive evaluation and management into comprehensive epilepsy care, particularly in resource-limited settings where cognitive morbidity may be underrecognized. Given the potential for cognitive difficulties to compound disability and adversely affect quality of life, identifying and addressing cognitive morbidity may be especially important in populations already facing substantial barriers to epilepsy care.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：认知障碍是癫痫患者（PWE）中常见的合并症，与残疾和生活质量下降相关。我们在秘鲁北部一个大型、基于人群的PWE队列中描述了认知障碍的负担，并识别了与认知表现相关的因素；该地区是猪带绦虫高度流行区，神经囊虫病（NCC）是获得性癫痫的常见原因。方法：2007年至2020年间，秘鲁北部基于人群的队列中纳入的PWE在入组时完成了简易精神状态检查（MMSE）。认知障碍定义为MMSE评分<24。收集了人口统计学和临床数据，包括癫痫特征和NCC状态。使用负二项回归分析识别与MMSE错误次数相关的因素。结果：在764名参与者中，平均MMSE评分为26.4（标准差4.2），16.4%符合认知障碍标准。记忆和注意力是最受影响的领域。在多变量分析中，年龄较大和受教育程度较低与较差的认知表现独立相关。结论：在秘鲁北部这一大型社区队列中，约六分之一的PWE在MMSE上表现出整体认知异常，其中记忆和注意力受影响最大。这些发现强调了将认知评估和管理纳入综合癫痫护理的重要性，尤其是在资源有限的环境中，认知 morbidity 可能未被充分认识。鉴于认知困难可能加重残疾并对生活质量产生不利影响，识别和解决认知 morbidity 在已经面临癫痫护理重大障碍的人群中可能尤为重要。

papers.title: New lesion formation is associated with accelerated brain aging in multiple sclerosis
papers.translated_title: 多发性硬化症中新病灶的形成与加速的脑老化相关
papers.author: La Rosa, F.
papers.summary: Background: Brain age is a biomarker of brain tissue integrity associated with disability in multiple sclerosis. While new lesion formation is central to MS diagnosis and treatment monitoring, its direct relationship to brain aging has not been established. Methods: We analyzed 163 people with MS with clinical and MRI assessments at baseline and years 3, 6, and 8. Brain age was estimated using BrainAgeNeXt. Annualized brain age acceleration was modeled as a function of radiological activity using generalized estimating equations, adjusting for age, sex, disease duration, baseline T2 lesion volume, normalized brain volume (NBV), brain age difference (BAD), and disease-modifying therapy. Secondary analyses examined dose-response effects, post-activity recovery, paramagnetic rim lesion (PRL) associations, and disability associations. Results: 105 participants had at least one new T2 lesion over 8 years. Radiologically active intervals (138 of 333) were associated with +0.19 yr/yr greater brain age acceleration than stable intervals (95% CI: 0.03-0.37; p=0.022), scaling with lesion count (beta=+0.18; p=0.001) and volume. Older age, greater baseline BAD, and NBV were independently associated with reduced brain age acceleration. Brain age acceleration in individuals with new lesions normalized during subsequent stable intervals (0.41 vs -0.06 yr/yr; p=0.001). Both PRLs and non-PRL lesions were associated with greater brain age acceleration than stable intervals. Baseline BAD, but not annualized acceleration, predicted Expanded Disability Status Scale (EDSS) and Nine-Hole Peg Test (9HPT) worsening. Conclusions: New focal lesion formation is associated with a quantifiable, dose-response acceleration of brain aging in MS that normalizes once lesion activity is suppressed.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：脑龄是反映多发性硬化症中脑组织完整性并关联残疾程度的生物标志物。尽管新病灶形成对多发性硬化症的诊断和治疗监测至关重要，但其与脑老化的直接关系尚未确立。方法：我们分析了163名多发性硬化症患者，在基线及第3、6、8年进行临床和MRI评估。使用BrainAgeNeXt估算脑龄。通过广义估计方程，将年化脑龄加速建模为放射学活动的函数，并调整年龄、性别、病程、基线T2病灶体积、标准化脑体积（NBV）、脑龄差（BAD）和疾病修饰治疗。次要分析考察了剂量-反应效应、活动后恢复、顺磁边缘病灶（PRL）关联及残疾关联。结果：105名参与者在8年内至少出现一个新T2病灶。放射学活动期（333个中的138个）与稳定期相比，脑龄加速增加+0.19年/年（95% CI：0.03-0.37；p=0.022），且随病灶数量（beta=+0.18；p=0.001）和体积呈比例增加。年龄较大、基线BAD较高和NBV较大与脑龄加速减少独立相关。新病灶个体的脑龄加速在随后的稳定期恢复正常（0.41 vs -0.06年/年；p=0.001）。PRL和非PRL病灶均与稳定期相比更大的脑龄加速相关。基线BAD，而非年化加速，预测了扩展残疾状态量表（EDSS）和九孔钉测试（9HPT）的恶化。结论：新局灶性病灶形成与多发性硬化症中可量化的、剂量-反应的脑老化加速相关，一旦病灶活动被抑制，这种加速即恢复正常。

papers.title: Inflammation Beyond the Disc: Circulating Inflammatory Biomarkers in Lumbar Disc Herniation and Degeneration--A Case-Control Study
papers.translated_title: 椎间盘之外的炎症：腰椎间盘突出与退变中的循环炎症生物标志物——一项病例对照研究
papers.author: Withanage, N. D.
papers.summary: Background: Lumbar disc herniation, with or without concomitant disc degeneration, is a major cause of lumbar radiculopathy and low back pain, which also a key public musculoskeletal disorder without an exact pathophysiology. Studies have suggested that inflammatory cells and biochemical markers of inflammation also play an important role in lumbar radiculopathy in addition to nerve compression. The aim of the present study was to assess the association of selected circulatory inflammatory markers (CRP, hs-CRP and E-selectin) in patients with lumbar disc herniation without radiological degeneration (LDH) and lumbar disc herniation with radiological degeneration (LDHD). Materials & methods: This case-control study included 208 participants, comprising 104 patients with lumbar disc pathology and 104 controls. Patients were further stratified into LDH (n=67) and LDHD (n=37). Serum CRP, hs-CRP and E-selectin concentrations were measured. Results: Among the patients, 35.6 % presented with LDHD while 64.4 % had only LDH. Significantly increased median hs-CRP (p<0.001) and CRP (p<0.001) were observed in patients groups compared to controls, while CRP showing a consistent independent association across the combined disease (OR=1.68, 95% CI=1.33-2.14, p<0.001), LDHD (OR=1.62, 95% CI=1.16-2.20, p=0.005) and LDH (OR=1.69, 95% CI=1.30-2.20, p<0.001) multivariable models. No significant difference was observed in serum E-selectin between the study groups. Multivariable models incorporating inflammatory and clinical variables demonstrated substantially greater discriminatory performance than individual biomarkers alone. Conclusion: Elevated circulating CRP and hs-CRP concentrations were associated with lumbar disc pathology, with CRP showing a consistent independent association across the combined disease, LDH and LDHD multivariable models, whereas E-selectin showed no significant association. Multivariable models incorporating inflammatory and clinical variables demonstrated greater discriminatory performance than individual biomarkers. These findings support a potential systemic inflammatory component in lumbar disc pathology, although the cross-sectional nature of the measurements does not establish causality or a local inflammatory response within the disc.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：腰椎间盘突出，无论是否伴有椎间盘退变，都是腰椎神经根病和腰痛的主要原因，也是一种缺乏确切病理生理机制的重要公共肌肉骨骼疾病。研究表明，除神经压迫外，炎症细胞和炎症生化标志物在腰椎神经根病中也发挥重要作用。本研究旨在评估无影像学退变的腰椎间盘突出（LDH）和有影像学退变的腰椎间盘突出（LDHD）患者中选定循环炎症标志物（CRP、hs-CRP和E-selectin）的关联。材料与方法：本病例对照研究纳入208名参与者，包括104名腰椎间盘病变患者和104名对照者。患者进一步分为LDH组（n=67）和LDHD组（n=37）。检测血清CRP、hs-CRP和E-selectin浓度。结果：在患者中，35.6%表现为LDHD，而64.4%仅有LDH。与对照组相比，患者组的hs-CRP（p<0.001）和CRP（p<0.001）中位数显著升高，且CRP在合并疾病（OR=1.68，95% CI=1.33-2.14，p<0.001）、LDHD（OR=1.62，95% CI=1.16-2.20，p=0.005）和LDH（OR=1.69，95% CI=1.30-2.20，p<0.001）多变量模型中均显示一致的独立关联。各组间血清E-selectin无显著差异。纳入炎症和临床变量的多变量模型显示出比单一生物标志物显著更高的判别性能。结论：循环CRP和hs-CRP浓度升高与腰椎间盘病变相关，其中CRP在合并疾病、LDH和LDHD多变量模型中均显示一致的独立关联，而E-selectin无显著关联。纳入炎症和临床变量的多变量模型显示出比单一生物标志物更高的判别性能。这些发现支持腰椎间盘病变中可能存在系统性炎症成分，但测量的横断面性质不能确立因果关系或椎间盘内的局部炎症反应。
